name: musicstream
description: MusicStream: one server runs the API (/api) and serves the built dashboard.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.release: npm run db:migrate && if [ -n "$SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD" ]; then npm run db:seed; fi
